# Email Verifier MCP

A Model Context Protocol (MCP) server that verifies email addresses using free DNS queries and an open-source disposable-domain blocklist. No third-party API, no API key, and no per-lookup fee for self-hosted use.

## Endpoint (hosted, zero setup)
- Streamable HTTP: https://neeenja--email-verifier-mcp.apify.actor/mcp
- Auth: `Authorization: Bearer <YOUR_APIFY_TOKEN>` (tool calls billed $0.005 each, pay-per-event)

## Self-host
- Source: https://github.com/PanStories/Email-Verifier-MCP
- Run: `git clone https://github.com/PanStories/Email-Verifier-MCP && cd Email-Verifier-MCP && npm i && npm start`
- License: MIT (free and unlimited when self-hosted)

## Tools
- `check_email` — full check on one address: RFC 5321 syntax, MX, disposable, role account; optional SMTP handshake. Returns a human summary + structured JSON.
- `verify_bulk` — same checks for up to 10 addresses at once, plus a summary line.
- `check_mx` — standalone MX lookup sorted by priority.
- `is_disposable` — is the address/domain a throwaway provider? Accepts `user@domain` or `domain`.

## Resources
- `blacklist://stats` — blocklist size and source (182,000+ disposable domains).

## Prompts
- `verify_signup_email` — accept / flag / reject decision template.

## Checks & scoring (additive, fully explainable)
- Syntax 20 · MX exists 30 · Not disposable 20 · Not role account 10 · SMTP reachable 10 · SMTP confirms mailbox 10.
- `valid = true` only when syntax passes, an MX record exists, and the domain is not disposable.
- `score` 80/100 means every DNS check passed; the last 20 points require the opt-in SMTP handshake.

## Compliance
- DNS-only by default — never opens an outbound SMTP connection, so it cannot be mistaken for port-25 scanning.
- The SMTP handshake is opt-in (`smtp: true`) and should run only from infrastructure you control.

## Pricing
- `initialize` / `tools/list`: free (agents can always connect and discover).
- Any tool call on the hosted endpoint: $0.005.
- Self-hosted (MIT): free and unlimited.

## Clients
Works with Claude Desktop, Cursor, Windsurf, GitHub Copilot, and any MCP client.
